name: Think Smart Discounts – Dynamic Pricing, Bulk Edit & Quantity Discounts for WooCommerce
author: ThinkPlugin

sections.description:
Think Smart Discounts is your all-in-one dynamic pricing and discount solution for WooCommerce, designed to boost your revenue with powerful, automated tools.

Whether you need a permanent bulk price editor for a quick sale, or want to set up “Buy 5, get 10% off” tiered pricing deals, our plugin provides the essential tools to build effective pricing strategies.

🚀 Free Version Features

Permanent Bulk Price Editor: Update prices of hundreds of products at once. Target all products, specific categories, or individual items.

Cart Discount (Spend & Save): Apply percentage discounts to the entire cart when a spending threshold is reached (e.g., “Spend $100, Get 10% Off”).

Quantity Discount (Tiered Pricing): Encourage bulk purchases with tiered rules (e.g., “Buy 5 items, get 20% off”).

⭐ Unlock Your Store’s Full Potential with PRO

Upgrade to Think Smart Discounts PRO for a complete marketing automation suite.
Boost your sales instantly! Unlock advanced features like BOGO deals, scheduling, customer loyalty programs, and more.

✅ Reversible Campaigns (Temporary Sales): Schedule sales and revert prices automatically.

✅ BOGO (Buy X, Get Y) Deals: Create powerful “Buy 1 Get 1” or “Buy 3 Get 1 Free” offers.

✅ Free Shipping Rules: Offer free shipping based on cart totals and targeted products.

✅ Loyalty Ladder: Reward repeat customers with better coupons as they spend more over time.

✅ Purchase History Discounts: Give automatic discounts to your loyal VIP customers.

✅ Page View Discounts: Convert guest visitors into buyers by offering a discount after viewing X pages.

✅ Review for Discount: Incentivize social proof by rewarding customers for approved reviews.

✅ Progress Bars & Countdowns: Create urgency and encourage higher cart values.

✅ Advanced Targeting: Apply any rule to specific categories or products.

Upgrade to PRO Now and Start Increasing Your Sales!
sections.installation:
Upload the think-smart-discounts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Go to the “Smart Discount” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I set up a quantity discount?

Go to “Smart Discount” > “Quantity Discount”. Set your minimum quantity and discount percentage.

Is the bulk pricing change reversible?

The free “Permanent Price Edit” feature is not reversible. For reversible sales and scheduled campaigns, you would need the PRO version.

Does this work with my theme?

Yes, Think Smart Discounts is designed to work with any theme that follows WooCommerce standards.
